chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated to me from his father from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Musa ibn Ja'far from Musa ibn 'Umayra from Hamzah ibn Bazee' from Ishaq ibn 'Amir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Applying kohl (antimony) before sleeping is a protection from the water (of the eyes).

key_terms.الْكُحْلُ: Kohl or antimony, a dark powder used as eye cosmetic and medicine
key_terms.الْمَاءِ: Water, referring here to the fluid of the eyes (tears)

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of applying kohl before sleeping according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the application of kohl before sleep is described as a safeguard against 'al-ma'' (watering or excessive tearing of the eyes), reflecting the Prophetic tradition of combining spiritual devotion with physical well-being. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on 'tibb al-nabawi' (Prophetic medicine), where simple daily acts are imbued with both health benefits and religious merit.
